name: Susuami
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible
sweep_summary: Susuami (susu1251) is not in the catalog and this search of works with stress in the title's single title hit is a false positive: Glottolog ref 458520 (Lehmann 1978, Old vs. Modern English verse rhythm) carries Susuami only by Glottolog's computerized assignment from the word 'contrasting' (record read and saved). No open source reached contains any statement of Susuami word stress. The only descriptive work is Smith, Geoffrey P. 1990, 'Susuami: An Angan Language of the Upper Watut Valley' (PNG Unitech Departmental Report 18, 16 pp., Glottolog listed by Glottolog as a wordlist;socling), confirmed as the primary description from the reference list of Smith 1992 (LLM 23, scanned text held by the project) and by Wikipedia; it is print-only and not online. The three other Smith works already held by the project (1988 Morobe counting systems, 1992 PL-C120 obsolescence, 1992 LLM 23 survival) were re-a full-text search for stress/accent and contain nothing on stress or accent. Acquisition priority for Smith 1990: high only if the 16-page report has a phonology section (Glottolog types it as wordlist/socling, so a stress statement is uncertain).
